title: Why keeping money safe is a slow way to lose it
description:
Cash in a low interest account loses value every year it sits there. The maths of a quiet loss.

New video every day.

scenes.say: You did the responsible thing. You saved. You did not gamble. And every year you got a little poorer.
Cash does not lose value in a way you can see. The number on the screen never drops. The number just stops meaning as much.
At three percent inflation, money sitting still loses about half its buying power in twenty three years.
Which means a safe account is not actually safe. It is a slow, almost guaranteed loss, dressed up as caution.
This is not an argument for taking risk. It is an argument for noticing that doing nothing is also a decision, and it has a price.
Safe and still are not the same word. Follow for more.
